name: Instagram Product Hero — Tea Tree Oil
description: 1080×1080 Instagram post template featuring a bold condensed headline over a product hero image with natural window-blind shadows providing text contrast.

HEADLINE.description: Two-line bold headline (newline separates lines). Rendered uppercase.

SUBHEADLINE.default: With Tea Tree Oil, You'll finally enjoy
SUBHEADLINE.description: Single italic subheadline below the headline.

heroImage.description: Background product/lifestyle photo (1080×1080 recommended). Natural shadows in the upper region provide text contrast.

brandFont.description: Primary headline font family. Must be a bold condensed sans-serif for best results.

brandBg.description: Fallback background color (visible if image fails to load). Matches the wall tone.

brandInk.description: Text color for headline and subheadline.

brandAccent.description: Accent color (derived from bottle amber). Available for optional decorative elements.

overlayStrength.description: Black gradient overlay opacity over the top portion of the image. Original uses natural photo shadows (~0.35 equivalent darkness). Increase for lighter hero images.

imageFocalX.description: Horizontal focal point of the hero image (object-position X). 49.2% centers on the product bottle.

imageFocalY.description: Vertical focal point of the hero image (object-position Y). 61% places the product in the lower-center.

headlineLine1.note: Measured at >90% white threshold; actual rendered cap-height ~60px

subheadline.note: Italic text, measured at strict threshold; actual height ~35px
